integrity: Public source dates and classification are checked against primary full text. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification covers precisely the minimum distinct-prime-support stratum. It neither classifies five-or-more-prime solutions nor establishes infinitude; numerical regression is ancillary to a cutoff-free proof. The three numerical examples occur in the 2023 literature, whereas the unconditional exhaustiveness is the added result.
title: Exact first-prime-support layer of the totient–divisor equation
